settings.headline: The hours after.
settings.body: Most aesthetic appointments leave skin that needs gentle handling. The Foaming Cleanser is built for that window — antibacterial, lightweight, formulated to cleanse treated skin without aggravating the area. Suited for use after lip fillers, microneedling, laser, SPMU, waxing, and any aesthetic procedure where the treated area benefits from a gentle post-appointment cleanse.
settings.image_alt: Editorial Senseless Foaming Cleanser bottle on a clean countertop

settings.title: Wait the time your practitioner recommends.
settings.body: Most aesthetic procedures have a specific aftercare window before cleansing.

settings.title: Apply a small amount of foam to the treated area.
settings.body: Pump once or twice. Foam works further than you'd expect.

settings.title: Cleanse gently. No rubbing.
settings.body: Light, circular motions. Let the foam do the work.

settings.title: Rinse with cool water and pat dry.

settings.headline: Senseless covers both halves of the appointment.
settings.body: The numbing range is the before. The Foaming Cleanser is the after. The two work together — not because they have to be used together, but because aesthetic appointments have two halves and Senseless is built for both. Most clients pair the Foaming Cleanser with whichever numbing tier suits their booking.
settings.image_alt: Editorial Senseless Foaming Cleanser with a numbing product nearby

settings.question: When do I use the Foaming Cleanser?
settings.answer: After your aesthetic appointment, once you're outside the immediate post-procedure window your practitioner recommends. Specific timing depends on the procedure.

settings.question: Can I use it daily, not just after appointments?
settings.answer: Yes. The Foaming Cleanser is gentle enough for daily use as a cleanser, particularly for sensitive skin or skin that's been worked on recently.

settings.question: Is this for face or body?
settings.answer: Primarily face, but suitable for any treated area — body waxing, body laser, brazilian aftercare. The formulation is gentle across treatment areas.

settings.question: Will it remove residue from Senseless numbing cream?
settings.answer: Yes — it can be used to remove any residual cream after the appointment if your practitioner hasn't already done so.

settings.question: Is this a medicine?
settings.answer: No. Senseless is a UK cosmetic product. Not a medicine. Not a pharmacy product.
